fault_comparison.limitations: Killed-child deliveries are excluded. Parent plus graceful peer counters are now consistently summed. Broker restart recovery times include readiness checks; not production SLOs. Cleanup emitted a legacy test-topic EOF warning after assertions.

causal_reproduction.setup: Hold durable commit from 8 to 16; reconnect with original grant and explicit fetch position 16; release writer after observing response or 250ms.
causal_reproduction.interpretation: Ignored resume cursor was pre-existing; committed-read window added deterministic exposure during in-flight append. Historical 16 records lack per-offset attribution and cannot all be proven to share this cause.

safety.scopes: Cursor correction applies only to cooperative requests. Eager behavior, protocol versions and persisted formats unchanged.
safety.recovery_bytes: Replay payload and metadata payload exclude replication traffic and record headers.
